Subject: Request: invoice-only start for pilot while PO is processed

Hi Mina / Ben,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — Sunloop is excited to kick the 30-day pilot. Procurement here needs a full PO to set up vendor billing, but our procurement lead is out until next week. To avoid delaying the pilot launch, would Redwood accept an invoice-only onboarding for the pilot (invoice on net-30) while the formal PO is routed? We can commit to an SOW addendum and a capped spend for the pilot.

Attached: Sunloop_SOW.pdf (SOW + pilot scope)

Key ask: start sandbox access and an initial seat allocation today; invoice to follow. We can provide a purchase order as soon as our procurement resource returns (expected 8/23).

Best,
Devon

devon@sunloop.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Request: invoice-only start for pilot while PO is processed

Hi Devon — thanks for the SOW and the clear timeline. Short answer: possible, with conditions.

We require a PO for vendors by default. For short pilots we do grant temporary invoice-only exceptions if Finance signs off and Procurement receives a completed exception form. Steps to move forward:
- Sunloop fills the Procurement Exception Form (I attached a blank to this thread).
- Ben / Sales to confirm a funding cap for the 30-day pilot (recommendation: $7,500).
- Procurement (Marissa) to review risk profile and approve one-time invoice-only path; Finance will open an AR ticket.

If Procurement approves, we can provision sandbox access today and issue an invoice at the end of the pilot. Please confirm you accept the cap and complete the form.

Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Business Operations
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

All — I reviewed Sunloop's paperwork and risk flags. Given the limited scope and the signed SOW, Procurement will approve a one-time invoice-only onboarding for the 30-day pilot under these controls: 

- Spend cap: $7,500 (invoice-only; any overage must be pre-approved and will require a PO)
- Procurement exception form must be completed and retained in vendor file (attached — filled)
- Finance will open AR ticket FIN-4521 and set net-30 terms; accounting will not process recurring billing without a PO
- Legal: short SOW with authorized signature must be on file

I have attached the completed procurement_exception_form_filled.pdf for records. This is a limited exception and will not set a precedent for larger engagements.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
